body: Notice of and Agenda for Joint Meeting of All City Commissions
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF AND AGENDA FOR
  JOINT MEETING OF ALL CITY COMMISSIONS

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Community Promotion Commission
will conduct a special meeting at 6:00 p.m. on May 31, 2024, in the Sproul
Reception Center, 12239 Sproul St, Norwalk, California. The purpose of this
special meeting is as follows:

  Social meet and greet among members of all City commissions. There will
be no discussion of any matter within the jurisdiction of each commission as
this is strictly a social occasion.

  NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that the public will be given the opportunity to
speak only on those matters listed in this notice.

Dated this 20 day of May, 2024.

Levy Sun
Staff Liaison to the Community Promotion Commission

  I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that
notice of this meeting was mailed to all commissioners and posted on May 20, 2024 and that
foregoing is true and correct. Said notice was posted at the following location(s).

X  City Hall
  Senior Center
  Social Services Center
X_  Other (describe) Sproul Reception Center, 12239 Sproul St, Norwalk, CA
 Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the Commission, Board or Committee on any matter listed on the agenda.
 The  Levy Sun
  Commission will hear public comment on matters not listed on the agenda during the Oral Communications period.
Signed:__
______________________________________
 Americans with Disabilities  Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or
 other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening devices are available at
 this meeting. Ask a staff member if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet,
 can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the
 meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
 accessibility to the meeting or service.
  Note: Commission agendas and minutes are available from the Staff Liaison or at the office of the City Clerk, City Hall, 12700
  Norwalk Boulevard during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. every
  other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720.
